svg.text: DWG DSV-GA-0042 REV C — ZONE GRID A–G / 1–5
GENERAL ARRANGEMENT — PRINCIPAL VIEWS, SECTIONS & SYSTEM LAYOUT — UNITS: METRES [M]

g.text: SADA WING DRIVE (±120°) AT EACH ROOT — PANELS: TRIPLE-JUNCTION PV, 30 kW EA @ 1 AU
LOX FEED Ø0.25 (VAC-JACKET THRU LH2) / LH2 FEED Ø0.30
DOCKING PORT — APAS-TYPE, Ø3.2 M TUNNEL
CARGO BAY — 6.0 M, VERTICAL BERTHING, 20 t
CREW MODULE — Ø6.0 PRESSURE VESSEL, 2 DECKS
AVIONICS BAYS — GNC / COMM / PDU / DMS
LOX TANK — Ø5.5 M, 45.9 t CAPACITY
LH2 TANK — Ø5.5 M, 6.1 t, 40 mm SOFI
ECLSS — O₂ / H₂O / CO₂ LOOP + SABATIER
SOLAR ARRAY WING — 10.0×3.0 M, 30 kW EA ×2
MAIN ENGINE — AE-480 ×3, 480 kN EA, ISP 455 s
UMBILICAL PANEL — GSE / LOX / LH2 QD
1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN METRES [M]. STATIONS (STA) MEASURED AFT FROM DOCKING PLANE = STA 0.
2. AXES: +X FWD (FLIGHT DIRECTION), +Z DORSAL (TOWARD AIRLOCK), +Y STBD. CG REF: STA 26.0 / Z 0.0.
3. CONFIGURATION SHOWN: CRUISE — ARRAYS & RADIATORS DEPLOYED, BAY DOORS CLOSED, GEAR DOWN.
4. RADIATOR PANELS DEPLOY NORMAL (±Z) TO SOLAR ARRAY PLANE — EDGE-ON TO SUN AT ALL TIMES.
5. SOLAR WINGS ARTICULATE ±120° ABOUT X-AXIS VIA SADA AT EACH ROOT.
6. INTERTANK SEPARATES LOX/LH2; LOX FEED Ø0.25 IS VACUUM-JACKETED THROUGH LH2 TANK.
7. PRIMARY STRUCTURE: AL-LI 2195 BARREL / CFRP FRAMES @ 1.0 M PITCH (F-14 … F-33 SHOWN).
8. MMOD SHIELDING: 2.5 mm WHIPPLE BUMPER ON ALL FWD AND +Z FACING SURFACES.
9. MAIN PROPULSION: 3× AE-480 STAGED-COMBUSTION, THROTTLE 20–100%, GIMBAL ±7° PITCH/YAW.
10. THERMAL: NH₃ PUMPED TWO-PHASE LOOP; RADIATOR AREA 96 M² TOTAL (4 PANELS × 24 M²).
11. POWER: 60 kW PV @ 1 AU DEGRADING WITH R²; 28 kWh LI-ION BUFFER STORAGE.
12. LANDING GEAR RATED 1.5 M/S SINK / 0.3 G LATERAL; SURFACE OPS ≤ SOL 30.
13. HIDDEN / PHANTOM LINES INDICATE STOWED OR OUT-OF-PLANE EQUIPMENT.
14. PROJECTION SYMBOL — THIRD ANGLE PER ASME Y14.3; CUT SURFACES HATCHED.
CDR UPDATE — RADIATOR RESIZE, ECLSS RELOC
ATLAS ASTRONAUTICS — DEEP SPACE SYSTEMS DIVISION
GENERAL ARRANGEMENT — PRINCIPAL VIEWS, SECTIONS & SYSTEMS
DO NOT SCALE DRAWING — REMOVE ALL BURRS AND SHARP EDGES
